description:
The process starts when a company schedules a compliance audit for regulations such as ISO standards, safety protocols, or environmental guidelines.
Internal teams prepare documentation, gather evidence, and conduct a self-assessment before the external audit.
Auditors review the company's processes and identify any gaps or issues.
After making the necessary corrections or improvements, the company undergoes a final audit.
If all criteria are met, the company is awarded certification, and the process concludes with the issuance of official documents.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComplianceAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Auditor" name="External Auditor"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DocumentationSubmitted" name="Submit documentation for external audit" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Participant_Auditor" messageRef="Message_AuditDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GapsReported" name="Report gaps and issues" sourceRef="Participant_Auditor" targetRef="Event_GapsIdentified" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalAuditRequested" name="Request final audit" sourceRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit" targetRef="Participant_Auditor" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalAuditResult" name="Final audit result" sourceRef="Participant_Auditor" targetRef="Event_FinalAuditResult" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditDocumentation" name="Audit documentation submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditFindings" name="Audit findings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FinalAuditRequest" name="Final audit request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FinalAuditResult" name="Final audit result"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company Compliance Audit" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_AuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GapsIdentified" name="Gaps and issues identified">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GapsIdentified" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CorrectImprove" name="Make corrections and improvements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestFinalAudit" name="Request final audit" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FinalAuditResult" name="Final audit result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalAuditResult" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet" name="All criteria met?" default="Flow_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" name="Issue official documents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_Certified" name="Certification issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_NotCertified" name="Certification not awarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Event_AuditScheduled" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Event_GapsIdentified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Event_GapsIdentified" targetRef="Task_CorrectImprove"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_CorrectImprove" targetRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit" targetRef="Event_FinalAuditResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Event_FinalAuditResult" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaMet" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allCriteriaMet}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaNotMet" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Event_NotCertified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" targetRef="Event_Certified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
